content.text: The group's story runs across four decades and three state capitals:

items: **1985:** Burswood Island Casino opened in Perth on 30 December with about 1,000 staff. At the time, it ranked among the largest casinos in the world.
**1994:** The Melbourne resort opened on Southbank.
**1996:** The group founded its own college to train hospitality and gaming staff.
**2002:** Melbourne opened an on-site support centre for players, which the group describes as the first of its kind.
**2020:** Sydney opened on 28 December after four years of construction, with capacity capped because of COVID.
**2024:** David Tsai, who spent more than 15 years at MGM Resorts, took over as group CEO in October.
**2025:** Perth turned 40 and buried a time capsule to be opened in 2065.
**2026:** Melbourne started a AUD 200 million upgrade, the biggest in 30 years. It supports about 2,000 construction jobs and aims to cut emissions by 23% by 2027.
